title: Mrs. Michal Tawil: Preparation for Shavuot (class # 18)

chapters.title: Introduction and tribute
chapters.about: Dedication of the class to the memory of the teacher's mother-in-law, Rina Bat Luna.

chapters.title: A story of commitment
chapters.about: The story of how the teacher's mother-in-law committed to lighting Shabbat candles.

chapters.title: Reflections on professional challenges
chapters.about: Learning from a stressful work experience and the need for emunah.

chapters.title: The Generation Tunnel Tour
chapters.about: Reflections on the desire for external validation and the importance of being a link in the chain to Avraham Abinu.

chapters.title: Personal avodah at home
chapters.about: Managing expectations and finding peace through personal responsibility.

chapters.title: Yom Yerushalayim and miracles
chapters.about: Reflecting on the Six-Day War and the fulfillment of nevuot.

chapters.title: Preparation for Shabuot
chapters.about: The significance of Shabuot and the Midrash regarding the acceptance of the Torah.

summary: Mrs. Tawil discusses the importance of developing emunah and self-appreciation independent of external validation, using personal stories from her work and family life. She also explores the spiritual significance of Shabuot as the time for accepting the Torah and reflects on the miracles of Yom Yerushalayim.
questions: How can we stop relying on others for appreciation and validation?
Why was the Torah given in the desert?
What does it mean to accept the Torah from an empty place within ourselves?
How do we reconcile the idea of free will with the Midrash that Hashem coerced B'nei Yisrael to accept the Torah?
